title: feat: connect Discord accounts
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Discord account linking while keeping GitHub as the only sign-in provider
- Enforces one connected Discord identity per Pollinations account
- Shows the linked Discord profile and Pollinations server membership with a session-only cached lookup
- Adds a 1-Pollen quest for connected users confirmed in the Pollinations Discord
- Adds an explicitly gated production sync for the three Discord secrets

gist.headline: The hive knows your handle
gist.blurb: Discord accounts can now be linked to Pollinations accounts without changing the GitHub-only sign-in flow. Join the Pollinations Discord, connect the dots, and a 1-Pollen quest is waiting in the garden.
gist.summary: Added Discord account linking to the account dashboard, including one Discord identity per Pollinations account, linked-profile and server-membership status, and a 1-Pollen quest for members confirmed in the Pollinations Discord.
gist.impact: Users can keep signing in with GitHub while connecting their Discord profile, seeing whether they are in the Pollinations server, and claiming Pollen for joining the community.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli connecting a glowing Discord-style chat badge to a cozy account terminal with a little garden path leading into the Pollinations community server. The monitor robot can eagerly verify a friendly member badge, while a small 1-Pollen reward flower blooms nearby; the visual metaphor is account linking as tying two warm garden threads together.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a tiny community garden hackerspace where Polli, a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears tiny moderator headphones while gently connects a Discord-style chat badge to a retro account terminal; a cute chunky CRT monitor robot holds a glowing verified member badge beside a blooming flower labeled "1 POLLEN." Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and vines, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, pixel-font text: "CONNECTED", nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
